style.name: Art Deco
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Art Deco / 装饰艺术风格. Build nine distinct premium editorial scenes with 1920s-30s metropolitan elegance, stepped skyscraper silhouettes, sunburst geometry, streamlined machinery, polished brass, black lacquer, deep emerald, midnight blue, ivory, chrome and restrained gold foil. Every news subject must become a different spatial narrative rather than a repeated template, generic sphere, three number cards or dashboard. Content, evidence, diagrams and story scenes occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. Reduce information density by about 20%, emphasize one conclusion and no more than three key facts in 3-5 large readable modules, and keep text on calm low-texture fields with generous spacing. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central Art Deco world-city or radiant globe, using sweeping rays, stepped architecture, overlapping metallic planes and varied quiet text fields rather than a rigid eight-cell grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Each overview sentence must remain complete, with clear 1-8 order and no extra event. Chinese and English keep the same composition, scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Use only the labels 虾子曰： and 豆豆龙： or Xiazi Says: and Doudoulong:. Put the exact text xiazishuo.com legibly in the bottom safe area of every poster. Every raw image must be native 1:2 portrait, every final image exactly 887x1774, with natural undistorted faces, circles, type and characters, and artwork filling all four edges with zero non-design white strips, pillarbox, letterbox or scaling gaps.

zh-CN.headlineView: Agent模型、一人获客SaaS、AI愿景App、跨境保健品、健康公平、生物多样性、水循环与软件并购进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 10月21日全球经营雷达；Agent模型、一人获客SaaS、AI愿景App、跨境保健品、健康公平、生物多样性、水循环与软件并购进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.intro:
1. MiniMax M3.1 Flash把Agent、编码、Computer Use与网络安全能力集中升级，官方称在线推理提速近3倍、Agent任务成本降低70%。
2. George Georgiadis自报一人将Happierleads做到150万美元ARR，以99美元起的访客识别、线索评分与外联平台服务B2B团队。
3. Stella用Claude Code与Google AI Studio把愿景可视化做成订阅App，创始人自报两个月达到约30万美元MRR和1.2万付费用户。
4. 美国保健品牌Obvi把含税结账、本地定价、合规与投放组合起来，一年内让国际收入占比从不足10%升至30%、年化超过1200万美元。
5. WHO首次系统评估全球非传染性疾病不平等，显示收入、教育、性别、年龄与居住地同时影响风险暴露和诊疗可及性。
6. 196个《生物多样性公约》缔约方在埃里温启动COP17，首次集体盘点昆明—蒙特利尔框架23项目标的落实进度。
7. NASA利用20多年GRACE卫星数据识别出40个与灌溉、水库和土地利用等人类活动显著相关的陆地水储量变化区。
8. Salesforce同意以约56.6亿美元企业价值收购Braze，用实时事件流和BrazeAI补强跨渠道客户互动能力。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号，是能力、收入与公共进展都必须能追溯到机制和证据。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 增长数字很亮，但来源、成本、限制和后续验证同样重要。

en-US.headlineView: Agent models, solo lead-gen SaaS, an AI visualization app, cross-border supplements, health equity, biodiversity, the water cycle and software M&A enter one action map
en-US.headlineFull: October 21 Global Operator Radar; Agent models, solo lead-gen SaaS, an AI visualization app, cross-border supplements, health equity, biodiversity, the water cycle and software M&A enter one action map
en-US.intro:
1. MiniMax M3.1 Flash upgrades agentic, coding, computer-use and cybersecurity capability together, with the maker claiming nearly 3x faster online inference and 70% lower agent-task cost.
2. George Georgiadis says he runs Happierleads alone at $1.5 million ARR, selling B2B visitor identification, lead scoring and outreach from $99 a month.
3. Stella used Claude Code and Google AI Studio to turn goal visualization into a subscription app, with its founder reporting about $300,000 MRR and 12,000 paying users in two months.
4. US wellness brand Obvi combined duty-inclusive checkout, local pricing, compliance and marketing to raise international revenue from below 10% to 30% of total and above a $12 million run rate in one year.
5. WHO's first systematic global assessment of NCD inequality shows that income, education, gender, age and residence shape both risk exposure and access to diagnosis and care.
6. The 196 Parties to the biodiversity convention opened COP17 in Yerevan for the first collective review of progress across the Kunming-Montreal framework's 23 targets.
7. NASA used more than two decades of GRACE satellite data to identify 40 terrestrial-water-storage regions strongly associated with irrigation, reservoirs, land-use change and other human activity.
8. Salesforce agreed to acquire Braze for about $5.66 billion in enterprise value, adding real-time event streaming and BrazeAI to its cross-channel customer-engagement stack.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared signal is that capability, revenue and public progress must all be traceable to mechanisms and evidence.
en-US.doudouQuote: Growth numbers shine, but sources, cost, limits and the next verification matter just as much.

zh-CN.headlineView: Agent、编码、Computer Use与网络安全同步提升，官方称在线推理提速近3倍、任务成本降低70%
zh-CN.headlineFull: MiniMax M3.1 Flash正式更新；Agent、编码、Computer Use与网络安全同步提升，官方称在线推理提速近3倍、任务成本降低70%
zh-CN.intro: MiniMax 10月19日正式更新M3.1 Flash，此前匿名处理超过200万亿token的Space Bunny是其早期版本。官方称新模型在复杂Agent任务、编程、Computer Use和网络安全上实现代际提升，在线推理速度接近上一代3倍，Agent任务综合使用成本降低70%；公开指标包括BankerToolBench 76.2、DeepSWE v1.1 73.7%、CyberGym 82%和OSWorld V2 61.7。模型支持100万token上下文以及文本、图像、视频输入，可通过MiniMax Code、M Plan和开发者平台使用。速度、成本和基准均为厂商口径，真实业务的工具成功率、稳定性、安全边界和总拥有成本仍需独立验证。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: Agent模型的竞争正从会不会做，转向能否更快、更便宜地完成整条任务链。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 70%是官方成本口径，拿自己的工作流做对照测试才算落地。

en-US.headlineView: Agentic, coding, computer-use and cybersecurity capability rise together, with nearly 3x faster inference and 70% lower task cost claimed
en-US.headlineFull: MiniMax M3.1 Flash officially launches; Agentic, coding, computer-use and cybersecurity capability rise together, with nearly 3x faster inference and 70% lower task cost claimed
en-US.intro: MiniMax officially updated M3.1 Flash on October 19; Space Bunny, which anonymously processed more than 200 trillion tokens, was an early version. The company says the model delivers a generational improvement across complex agent tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity, with online inference nearly three times faster and total usage cost on agentic tasks 70% lower than the previous generation. Published scores include 76.2 on BankerToolBench, 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1, 82% on CyberGym and 61.7 on OSWorld V2. It supports a one-million-token context plus text, image and video input through MiniMax Code, M Plan and the developer platform. Speed, cost and benchmarks are vendor claims; tool success, stability, safety boundaries and total cost still need independent testing on real workflows.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Agent-model competition is moving from whether it can act to whether it can finish the whole chain faster and cheaper.
en-US.doudouQuote: The 70% figure is a vendor cost claim; test it against your own workflow before calling it deployed.

sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Redefining Agent Performance and Cost

zh-CN.headlineFact: Happierleads创始人自报一人做到150万美元ARR
zh-CN.headlineView: 把访客识别、数据补全、AI评分、邮件外联和CRM连接捆成99美元起的B2B结果平台
zh-CN.headlineFull: Happierleads创始人自报一人做到150万美元ARR；把访客识别、数据补全、AI评分、邮件外联和CRM连接捆成99美元起的B2B结果平台
zh-CN.intro: 伦敦创始人George Georgiadis称自己没有联合创始人、没有风投和大型团队，独自把Happierleads做到150万美元ARR。产品面向B2B营销与销售团队，把匿名网站访客识别、已验证联系人、AI线索评分、意向数据、邮件序列和HubSpot、Salesforce、Pipedrive等CRM连接放在同一平台，月费99美元起，年付节省30%。获客依赖创始人内容、直接演示、代理商合作和集成伙伴，交付通过软件、数据网络与自动化完成，创始人仍亲自读取功能请求和处理部分支持。收入和团队规模来自创始人自报而非支付平台审计；隐私合规、数据准确率、外联送达率、第三方数据成本及单人支持瓶颈是主要限制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司赚钱的杠杆，是把五个分散工具压缩成客户愿意持续付费的结果链。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 150万美元ARR是创始人自报，数据合规与支持容量决定能否长期维持。

en-US.headlineFact: Happierleads founder reports $1.5M ARR as a solo operator
en-US.headlineView: Visitor ID, enrichment, AI scoring, email outreach and CRM connections become one B2B outcome platform from $99 a month
en-US.headlineFull: Happierleads founder reports $1.5M ARR as a solo operator; Visitor ID, enrichment, AI scoring, email outreach and CRM connections become one B2B outcome platform from $99 a month
en-US.intro: London founder George Georgiadis says he built Happierleads to $1.5 million ARR without a co-founder, venture funding or a large team. The B2B marketing and sales platform combines anonymous website-visitor identification, verified contacts, AI lead scoring, intent data, email sequencing and CRM connections including HubSpot, Salesforce and Pipedrive. Plans start at $99 a month and annual billing saves 30%. Acquisition runs through founder content, direct demos, agency partnerships and integrations; delivery is software, a data network and automation, while the founder still reads feature requests and handles some support. Revenue and team size are founder-reported rather than payment-provider audited. Privacy compliance, data accuracy, email deliverability, third-party data cost and a solo support bottleneck remain the main limits.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The leverage in a one-person company is compressing five scattered tools into an outcome customers keep paying for.
en-US.doudouQuote: $1.5 million ARR is founder-reported; data compliance and support capacity determine durability.

sources.title: Meet George — Founder of Happierleads
Collaborate with George Georgiadis

zh-CN.headlineFact: Stella创始人自报两个月约30万美元MRR
zh-CN.headlineView: Claude Code与Google AI Studio把愿景可视化做成订阅App，1.2万付费用户来自既有内容受众
zh-CN.headlineFull: Stella创始人自报两个月约30万美元MRR；Claude Code与Google AI Studio把愿景可视化做成订阅App，1.2万付费用户来自既有内容受众
zh-CN.intro: Stella是一款面向自我提升与愿景练习的移动App，用户输入工作、关系、金钱或自信等目标后，AI生成可反复观看的个性化可视化内容。创始人Sarah称自己不是传统程序员，用Claude Code与Google AI Studio约两天做出第一版；Starter Story采访口径显示上线两个月达到约30万美元MRR，采访时约35万至36万美元、1.2万付费用户和超过20万下载。变现来自移动订阅，获客主要依赖她原有的Instagram和TikTok大规模受众，AI把原型与内容生产成本压低。收入和用户数字为创始人自报、未独立审计；平台抽成、退款、续订、内容安全和过度依赖个人流量是核心风险，MRR也不等于利润。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI把开发门槛压低以后，真正稀缺的是已经建立信任的受众与明确的付费习惯。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 30万美元MRR来自创始人自报，留存和平台成本才决定现金质量。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineFact: Stella founder reports about $300K MRR in two months
en-US.headlineView: Claude Code and Google AI Studio turned goal visualization into a subscription app, with 12,000 paying users drawn from an existing creator audience
en-US.headlineFull: Stella founder reports about $300K MRR in two months; Claude Code and Google AI Studio turned goal visualization into a subscription app, with 12,000 paying users drawn from an existing creator audience
en-US.intro: Stella is a mobile self-improvement and visualization app: users enter goals around work, relationships, money or confidence, and AI generates personalized visual content they can revisit. Founder Sarah says she was not a traditional programmer and built the first version in roughly two days with Claude Code and Google AI Studio. Figures attributed to her Starter Story interview put the app at about $300,000 MRR after two months and roughly $350,000-to-$360,000 by the interview, with 12,000 paying users and more than 200,000 downloads. Mobile subscriptions monetize the product, while her large Instagram and TikTok audience supplied distribution and AI reduced prototype and content-production cost. The figures are founder-reported and not independently audited; app-store fees, refunds, renewal, content safety and dependence on personal distribution are key risks, and MRR is not profit.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Once AI lowers the development barrier, the scarce assets are trusted distribution and a clear paid habit.
en-US.doudouQuote: $300,000 MRR is founder-reported; retention and platform cost determine the quality of cash flow.

sources.title: Stella: MVP in 2 Days, $350K/Month in 2 Months
How an AI-Built Creator App Hit $360K MRR in Just Two Months

zh-CN.headlineFact: Obvi国际收入占比一年升至30%
zh-CN.headlineView: 含税结账、本地定价、标签合规与效果投放把保健品跨境业务推到1200万美元以上年化
zh-CN.headlineFull: Obvi国际收入占比一年升至30%；含税结账、本地定价、标签合规与效果投放把保健品跨境业务推到1200万美元以上年化
zh-CN.intro: 美国保健品牌Obvi销售胶原蛋白与代谢类产品，过去国际订单来自英国、加拿大和澳大利亚，但VAT、进口税、保健品标签和履约复杂度让海外收入长期不足10%。品牌与OpenBorder合作，把含税到手价、本地化定价、税务与标签合规、履约跟踪及效果营销组合起来，并扩展到Amazon International和TikTok Shop等渠道。服务商案例称一年内国际收入占比升至30%，国际业务年化超过1200万美元，新市场从第一天即实现盈利，广告回报约为美国本土的2倍。赚钱机制是把已有需求转成可结账、可合规、可重复投放的订单；但数据来自服务商与品牌自报，产品毛利、退货、监管变化、广告成本和供应链波动仍决定净利润。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境电商真正赚钱，不只是把页面翻译出来，而是让价格、合规、渠道和交付同时成立。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 1200万美元是国际年化收入，不是利润；保健品合规和投放成本必须持续核算。

en-US.headlineFact: Obvi raised international revenue to 30% of total in one year
en-US.headlineView: Duty-inclusive checkout, local pricing, label compliance and performance marketing pushed the wellness brand above a $12M international run rate
en-US.headlineFull: Obvi raised international revenue to 30% of total in one year; Duty-inclusive checkout, local pricing, label compliance and performance marketing pushed the wellness brand above a $12M international run rate
en-US.intro: US wellness brand Obvi sells collagen and metabolism products. Orders had arrived from the UK, Canada and Australia, but VAT, import duties, supplement labeling and fulfilment complexity kept international revenue below 10% of total. With OpenBorder, the brand combined duty-inclusive landed pricing, localization, tax and label compliance, tracked fulfilment and performance marketing, while expanding into channels including Amazon International and TikTok Shop. The provider case says international revenue reached 30% of total within one year, exceeded a $12 million annual run rate, became profitable from day one in new markets and delivered roughly twice domestic return on ad spend. The mechanism converts existing demand into orders that can clear checkout, compliance and delivery. Results are vendor- and brand-reported; product margin, returns, regulatory change, ad cost and supply-chain volatility still determine net profit.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Profitable cross-border commerce is not a translated page; pricing, compliance, channel and delivery must work together.
en-US.doudouQuote: $12 million is an international revenue run rate, not profit; supplement compliance and acquisition cost require continuous accounting.

sources.title: How Obvi Grew International to 30% of Revenue

zh-CN.headlineFact: WHO首次系统评估全球非传染性疾病不平等
zh-CN.headlineView: 收入、教育、性别、年龄与居住地同时影响癌症、心血管病、慢性呼吸病和糖尿病的风险与诊疗
zh-CN.headlineFull: WHO首次系统评估全球非传染性疾病不平等；收入、教育、性别、年龄与居住地同时影响癌症、心血管病、慢性呼吸病和糖尿病的风险与诊疗
zh-CN.intro: WHO 10月20日发布《不平等状况：非传染性疾病及其风险因素》，首次在全球尺度系统衡量不同人群在癌症、心血管疾病、慢性呼吸疾病和糖尿病及其风险因素上的差异。过去10年的国家数据表明，低中收入国家受教育程度较低的人群往往有更高的高血压和糖尿病比例，贫困和低教育女性更少接受宫颈癌筛查，农村居民更难获得高血压诊疗和筛查。性别、年龄、失业、残障和移民身份还会叠加烟草、酒精、肥胖、运动不足及空气污染风险。报告同时指出部分国家缺少分层数据，下一步需要把不平等监测用于资源配置、普惠干预和服务覆盖，而不是只记录差异。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 同一种疾病并不意味着同一种机会，健康风险和获得治疗的路径都被社会条件塑造。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 没有分层数据，就很难看见谁被筛查、诊断和治疗系统遗漏。

en-US.headlineFact: WHO makes its first systematic global assessment of NCD inequality
en-US.headlineView: Income, education, gender, age and residence shape risk and care for cancer, cardiovascular disease, chronic respiratory disease and diabetes
en-US.headlineFull: WHO makes its first systematic global assessment of NCD inequality; Income, education, gender, age and residence shape risk and care for cancer, cardiovascular disease, chronic respiratory disease and diabetes
en-US.intro: WHO released State of inequality: noncommunicable diseases and their risk factors on October 20, the first systematic global measurement of differences across population groups in four major NCDs and their risks. National data from the past decade show that in low- and middle-income countries, less-educated populations often have higher hypertension and diabetes rates; poorer and less-educated women receive less cervical-cancer screening; and rural residents have less access to hypertension diagnosis, treatment and screening. Gender, age, unemployment, disability and migration status also interact with tobacco, alcohol, obesity, inactivity and air-pollution exposure. The report warns that some countries still lack disaggregated data. The next step is to use inequality monitoring for resource allocation, population-wide intervention and service coverage rather than merely documenting gaps.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The same disease does not mean the same chance; social conditions shape both risk and the path to care.
en-US.doudouQuote: Without disaggregated data, it is hard to see who screening, diagnosis and treatment systems leave behind.

sources.title: WHO report examines inequalities in noncommunicable diseases and their risk factors

zh-CN.headlineFact: COP17在埃里温启动首次全球生物多样性进度盘点
zh-CN.headlineView: 196个缔约方检视昆明—蒙特利尔框架23项目标，并谈判加速行动的“埃里温路径”
zh-CN.headlineFull: COP17在埃里温启动首次全球生物多样性进度盘点；196个缔约方检视昆明—蒙特利尔框架23项目标，并谈判加速行动的“埃里温路径”
zh-CN.intro: 《生物多样性公约》第17次缔约方大会于10月19日至30日在亚美尼亚埃里温举行，196个缔约方与政府、科研、原住民、青年和企业代表参加。会议处在2022年昆明—蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架与2030年目标的中点，将首次集体审视23项目标的落实进度，包括到2030年保护至少30%陆地与海洋、改善融资并削减有害补贴。根据盘点，行动正在增加但速度与规模仍不足；各方将据此谈判“埃里温路径”，把承诺转化为可衡量的国家行动。最大约束是保护融资缺口、国家目标强度不一、数据可比性以及补贴改革的政治成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 生物多样性大会的关键，不是再写一份愿景，而是把23项目标变成可核验的进度。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 2030只剩四年，融资、数据和国家执行力决定埃里温路径能否落地。

en-US.headlineFact: COP17 opens the first global biodiversity progress review in Yerevan
en-US.headlineView: The 196 Parties assess the Kunming-Montreal framework's 23 targets and negotiate a Yerevan Pathway to accelerate action
en-US.headlineFull: COP17 opens the first global biodiversity progress review in Yerevan; The 196 Parties assess the Kunming-Montreal framework's 23 targets and negotiate a Yerevan Pathway to accelerate action
en-US.intro: The 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity runs from October 19 to 30 in Yerevan, Armenia, bringing together 196 Parties and representatives from governments, science, Indigenous peoples, youth and business. At the midpoint between the 2022 Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework and its 2030 deadline, this is the first collective review of progress across 23 targets, including protecting at least 30% of land and sea, increasing finance and reducing harmful subsidies. The initial stocktake says action is increasing but not at the speed and scale required. Parties will negotiate a Yerevan Pathway intended to turn commitments into measurable national action. The main constraints are the finance gap, uneven national ambition, comparable data and the political cost of subsidy reform.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The biodiversity summit matters only if 23 targets become verifiable progress, not another vision statement.
en-US.doudouQuote: With four years to 2030, finance, data and national execution will decide whether the Yerevan Pathway works.

sources.title: Spotlight on COP 17: Announcements from Yerevan
Protecting Earth's fragile biodiversity takes spotlight at Armenia talks

zh-CN.headlineFact: 卫星找到人类活动改变陆地水循环的40个区域
zh-CN.headlineView: 20多年GRACE数据把灌溉、水库和土地利用变化与地下水和地表水储量趋势对应起来
zh-CN.headlineFull: 卫星找到人类活动改变陆地水循环的40个区域；20多年GRACE数据把灌溉、水库和土地利用变化与地下水和地表水储量趋势对应起来
zh-CN.intro: NASA研究团队结合GRACE与GRACE-FO卫星从2002年4月至2025年11月的重力测量，把陆地水储量长期趋势的空间细节提高到以往分析的5至10倍。研究在除澳大利亚外的所有非极地大陆识别出40个水储量变化与人类活动显著相关的区域，因素包括地下水灌溉、水库蓄水、运河和土地利用变化。加州中央谷地、美国南部高平原、墨西哥奇瓦瓦和印度北部因抽取地下水而下降，部分非洲雨养农地、巴西马拉尼昂和俄罗斯大型水库则出现增加。方法牺牲了部分时间分辨率，统计相关也不等于每处都已证明单一因果；研究下一步将结合月度产品，跟踪干旱与政策变化后的动态。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 水循环不再只是天气的结果，农田、水库、运河和城市也在给地球留下重力指纹。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 40个区域显示强关联，因果和政策效果仍需更细的时间数据验证。

en-US.headlineFact: Satellites identify 40 regions where people alter terrestrial water storage
en-US.headlineView: More than two decades of GRACE data connect irrigation, reservoirs and land-use change with groundwater and surface-water trends
en-US.headlineFull: Satellites identify 40 regions where people alter terrestrial water storage; More than two decades of GRACE data connect irrigation, reservoirs and land-use change with groundwater and surface-water trends
en-US.intro: A NASA-led study combined GRACE and GRACE-FO gravity measurements from April 2002 through November 2025 and mapped long-term terrestrial-water-storage trends at five-to-ten times the spatial detail of previous analyses. It identified 40 regions on every nonpolar continent except Australia where storage change was significantly associated with human activity, including groundwater irrigation, reservoir filling, canals and land-use change. Storage declined with pumping in California's Central Valley, the southern US High Plains, Chihuahua and northern India, while increases appeared in some rainfed African farmland, Brazil's Maranhao state and major Russian reservoirs. The method sacrifices some temporal resolution, and statistical association does not establish one cause everywhere. Next, researchers plan to combine it with monthly products to follow drought and policy effects over time.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The water cycle is no longer only a result of weather; farms, reservoirs, canals and cities leave a gravity fingerprint on Earth.
en-US.doudouQuote: Forty regions show strong association; causality and policy effects still need finer time-series testing.

sources.title: Spatially refined satellite gravimetry captures human signatures in global terrestrial water storage trends

zh-CN.headlineView: 每股47.50美元现金，把实时事件流、多渠道互动与BrazeAI并入营销云和Agentforce体系
zh-CN.headlineFull: Salesforce同意以约56.6亿美元收购Braze；每股47.50美元现金，把实时事件流、多渠道互动与BrazeAI并入营销云和Agentforce体系
zh-CN.intro: Salesforce 10月20日宣布与Braze签署最终收购协议，交易企业价值约56.6亿美元，Braze A类股股东将获得每股47.50美元现金。Braze以云原生事件流实时更新客户画像，并在App、网站、邮件、短信和WhatsApp等渠道协调个性化互动；BrazeAI用于优化内容、优惠、渠道和触达时机。Salesforce计划把这些能力接入Data 360、Customer 360、Agentforce与SIForce，以补强面向消费者的实时营销。交易预计在Salesforce 2028财年完成，仍需Braze股东和监管机构批准；整合复杂度、客户迁移、产品重叠和能否兑现协同收入是主要风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 这笔交易买的不是一组营销功能，而是一条能实时响应客户行为的数据与决策链。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 签署协议不等于完成收购，监管、整合和客户留存仍是三道门。

en-US.headlineFact: Salesforce agrees to acquire Braze for about $5.66B
en-US.headlineView: $47.50 a share in cash brings real-time event streaming, multichannel engagement and BrazeAI into the Marketing Cloud and Agentforce stack
en-US.headlineFull: Salesforce agrees to acquire Braze for about $5.66B; $47.50 a share in cash brings real-time event streaming, multichannel engagement and BrazeAI into the Marketing Cloud and Agentforce stack
en-US.intro: Salesforce announced a definitive agreement on October 20 to acquire Braze for about $5.66 billion in enterprise value, with holders of Braze Class A stock receiving $47.50 a share in cash. Braze uses cloud-native event streaming to update customer profiles in real time and coordinate personalized experiences across apps, websites, email, SMS and WhatsApp; BrazeAI optimizes content, offers, channels and timing. Salesforce plans to connect those capabilities with Data 360, Customer 360, Agentforce and SIForce to strengthen real-time consumer marketing. The deal is expected to close in Salesforce's fiscal 2028 and still requires Braze shareholder and regulatory approval. Integration complexity, customer migration, product overlap and whether promised revenue synergies materialize are the main risks.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The deal buys more than marketing features; it buys a data-and-decision chain that reacts to customer behavior in real time.
en-US.doudouQuote: Signing is not closing; regulation, integration and customer retention remain three separate gates.
